title: Summarize a feature delay with an unaffected parallel workstream (hard)
prompt: Summarize the following in two sentences: Engineering originally planned to ship the new search feature by the end of this month, but a critical dependency (the updated indexing service) was delayed by three weeks due to an unrelated infrastructure migration; as a result, the search feature launch has been pushed to next month, though the team has already begun parallel work on a related ranking improvement that is unaffected by the delay and remains on its original schedule.

metadata.hard_reason: Requires distinguishing what IS delayed (search feature, due to the indexing dependency) from what is NOT delayed (the ranking improvement) - a real test of whether the model tracks two separate timelines correctly instead of conflating them.
metadata.notes: Correct: two sentences that keep the delayed search feature and the on-schedule ranking improvement clearly separate. Graded manually - conflating the two timelines is a failure.
